summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of KDPLUS Pharmacy POS. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests passed covering auth (email/pw + PIN + refresh + forgot), catalog, products CRUD, inventory (levels/lots/expiry/receive/adjust/movements), POS regular sale w/ VAT, split payment, Senior/PWD (VAT-exempt + 20%), offline dedupe via client_txn_id, refunds w/ stock restore, purchase orders create+receive, customers + loyalty, reports (dashboard, sales-summary all 4 groups, inventory-valuation, senior-pwd), shifts open/move/close, employees, settings persistence, audit log, global search. Frontend (Playwright): admin login → Dashboard, PIN login (4444) → POS register, full regular sale end-to-end with receipt (VAT ₱31.07 on ₱290 = 12% correct), Senior/PWD dialog shows correct math (₱145 gross → VAT-exempt -₱15.54 → 20% -₱25.89 → total ₱103.57), navigation to Products (47 rows), Inventory (Expiry + Ledger tabs), Reports (Net Sales ₱40,425.71, Gross Profit ₱13,172.31, 32.6% margin, Sales/Inventory/Senior tabs + Export CSV), Sales, Customers, Purchase Orders, Shifts, Employees, Audit Log, Settings all loaded with 0 console/page errors.

issues: Shows 'Loading dashboard...' briefly; a skeleton state would be nicer, but content does load. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: CORS uses env FRONTEND_URL + localhost only with allow_credentials=True — correct (no wildcard). Good.
Auth cookies set httpOnly via set_auth_cookies (core.py). Login response returns public_user without password_hash. Good.
Money math uses Decimal + m() helper server-side; VAT-inclusive extraction (net = gross / (1+vat_rate)) is decimal-safe. Verified numerically for both regular and Senior/PWD sales.
client_txn_id dedupe short-circuits before any inventory/loyalty side effects — correct idempotency.
FEFO allocation on POS create_sale + consume_lots + record_movement flow is coherent; refunds restore stock via REFUND movement.

PUT /api/products/{pid} requires the FULL ProductIn body (no Optional partial-update model). Not a bug but consider a PatchProduct model if the frontend ever wants partial updates. Frontend Products.jsx must send full doc when editing (verified working).
seed_all runs on every startup wrapped in try/except; safe. Consider gating with a flag to avoid re-seeding demo sales in prod.
Some route modules are large (routes_pos.py ~370 lines) — acceptable, but consider splitting shifts/cash out of routes_pos for readability.

response.delete_cookie in /logout does not pass samesite/secure; browsers may keep the cookie until natural expiry. Not a functional issue since JWT is short-lived, but consider matching original cookie attributes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all pages loaded, 0 errors, sale flow completed)

Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 34 tests, run with: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`). Frontend uses cookie auth (withCredentials); Dashboard route is `/` (not `/dashboard`). PUT /api/products/{pid} requires full ProductIn payload.
